What matches

  • Outline and height match closely: 91% of the outline overlaps.
  • The stacked hoops read as lorica bands.

What is off

  • The chest plates split down the middle; your cuirass is closed at the front.
  • The shoulder guards are too flat and too square.
  • Your hoops are deeper and more stepped than mine.

What I did

  1. Built a cuirass generator. Six overlapping hoops for the torso bands, front and back chest plates with a neck scoop, and three stepped guard plates over each shoulder. Every piece is generated by Python in Blender, then given paper thickness and flat facets.
  2. Cut out your image. I separated the cuirass from the backdrop so its outline can be scored.
  3. Found your camera. I tried several turns and kept the one whose outline matched best.
  4. Fitted the shape. 300 small changes to the dimensions, each kept only if the outline got closer.
  5. Fitted light and paper. 20 rendered rounds tuning light, paper colour and backdrop.
  6. Second pass. Camera held to a sensible range, cream paper and builder fixes, then fitted again.
